what: Stretches the proxy run could not render well (skipped) or failed: they need a source clip exported from the ORIGINAL footage on the PC (PC-SESSION-PROMPT.md JOB 2b with this file instead of export-plan.json). start/end = the owner’s cut when custom is true, else the scan’s stretch, in seconds of the original. why = what the proxy run saw.

items.why: skipped: No repetition in this stretch (3.4 to 10.9 s): the athlete walks in and then only holds the pike pose. The dive-bomber reps start at about 13 s, which is stretch b306f66d4f-02 (rendered from that part).
